name.title: Name
name.description: Shown as the prefix on this plugin's log lines and as its title in the Homebridge UI.

port.title: Port
port.description: [Optional] UDP port this plugin listens on. Devices also announce themselves on this port when they power up, so keep the default unless something else uses it.

enableScenes.title: Enable Scenes
enableScenes.description: [Optional] Turn on support for scenes with your lightbulbs. THIS WILL MAKE IT IMPOSSIBLE TO GROUP LIGHTS

lastStatus.title: Last Status
lastStatus.description: [Optional] Lights will remember the last mode used when turned on (light settings in HomeKit will be ignored).

broadcast.title: Broadcast Address
broadcast.description: [Optional] UDP Broadcast address for device discovery.

address.title: Server Address
address.description: [Optional] This server's IP address, sent in discovery requests. Autodetected when empty. The plugin always listens on all interfaces.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: [Optional] Seconds between background state checks of each device. Detects devices that went offline and keeps HomeKit in sync with changes made elsewhere. 0 = off. Default: 30.

discoveryInterval.title: Discovery Interval (seconds)
discoveryInterval.description: [Optional] Seconds between discovery broadcasts (minimum 10). Devices that power up are also picked up immediately from their own announcement, so this is a fallback. 0 = startup only. Default: 60.

pingFailuresBeforeOffline.title: Ping Failures Before Offline
pingFailuresBeforeOffline.description: [Optional] Consecutive failed exchanges before a device shows as 'No Response'. It recovers automatically as soon as it answers or announces itself. Default: 3.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: [Optional] Devices to name, or to reach directly by IP when broadcast does not reach them. Match by IP or MAC.

ignoredDevices.title: Ignored Devices
ignoredDevices.description: [Optional] Devices to leave out of HomeKit. Match by IP or MAC. Already-added ones are removed on the next start.
